name: traderspy
description: Read-only crypto futures market data for AI agents: AI-generated signals, top-trader positions on Hyperliquid, Binance, Bybit and OKX, 19 technical indicators, funding and open interest, a screener and event-study backtests. No order, transfer or withdrawal tools. Not financial advice.

TRADERSPY_API_KEY.description: Personal key from the Other clients tab at https://traderspy.app/mcp (starts with mcp_). Only needed for clients that cannot do OAuth; a free account is enough.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Recent AI-generated futures signals, filterable by symbol and side: entry, TP1-TP3, stop, strength and validation score.

tools.name: get_signal_details
tools.description: One signal in full: AI review, trigger conditions, every level as an absolute price, its resolution status and the live price.

tools.name: get_signal_stats
tools.description: Signal history over a period: win rate, profit factor and resolution breakdown.

tools.name: get_top_traders
tools.description: Ranked top traders per exchange (Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit, OKX) by ROI, PnL or score over 24h to 30d.

tools.name: get_elite_leaderboard
tools.description: Cross-exchange top 10 traders by SmartScore, with the scoring rationale.

tools.name: get_trader_profile
tools.description: One trader's metrics plus their open positions.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Open and closed smart-money positions, filterable by symbol, exchange and status.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Aggregate long/short counts, notional and PnL across tracked traders.

tools.name: get_exchanges
tools.description: Which exchanges are tracked and enabled.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Real-time price, 24h high/low, volume and change for one or many symbols.

tools.name: get_technical_indicators
tools.description: 19 indicators (RSI, MACD, EMA, SMA, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend and more) over up to 3 timeframes and 3 symbols, with a cross-timeframe confluence summary.

tools.name: get_derivatives
tools.description: Funding rate, open interest, long/short ratios and taker flow for Binance perpetuals.

tools.name: screen_symbols
tools.description: Screen the most-traded pairs against up to three conditions over 17 metrics, or compare a list of symbols.

tools.name: backtest_condition
tools.description: Event study of what price did after a condition on one symbol and timeframe, against the unconditional baseline.

tools.name: get_tracked_symbols
tools.description: Every symbol with real-time data available.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in with a free TraderSpy account.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP with a personal key instead of OAuth, for clients without a sign-in window.
